name: E2B
description: Open-source Firecracker microVM sandboxes for AI agent code execution.
descriptionZh: 面向 AI Agent 代码执行的开源 Firecracker microVM 沙箱。
keyFact: E2B runs each agent session in its own Firecracker microVM with a dedicated guest kernel, reporting roughly 150-200ms warm and 300-500ms cold start; its core runtime is Apache-2.0 and can be self-hosted via E2B Embed or Terraform on AWS/GCP, alongside the vendor's managed cloud.
keyFactZh: E2B 为每个 Agent 会话启动独立的 Firecracker microVM（专属 guest 内核），官方给出的启动时间为热启动约 150-200ms、冷启动约 300-500ms；其核心运行时以 Apache-2.0 开源，可通过 E2B Embed 或 Terraform 自托管到 AWS/GCP，同时也提供官方托管云。
caveat: The runtime is Apache-2.0 while the Python SDK package is published under MIT; most teams use the managed cloud rather than self-hosting.
caveatZh: 运行时为 Apache-2.0，而 Python SDK 包标注为 MIT；多数团队使用其托管云而非自托管。
